phase_i.graph: G_host=(V,E) from host audit records; nodes are system entities/events and edges are causal dependencies
phase_i.evaluation_subgraphs: Louvain community partitioning; hub nodes may be repeated for context
phase_i.input: G_k=(A_k,X_k), with binary adjacency A_k and node feature matrix X_k

semantics.1: at least one malicious entity or attack stage

phase_ii.mask: M_hat_k; soft retain mask sigmoid(M_hat_k); A_tilde_k=A_k elementwise-multiplied by sigmoid(M_hat_k)
phase_ii.objective: minimize structural distance subject to detector prediction flip
losses: L_pred minimizes probability of original threat prediction
phase_ii.intervention: remove selected edges and suppress features of incident endpoints before fixed-detector evaluation
phase_ii.mer: mean indicator that intervention flips f(G_k)

paper_parameters.negative_sampling: random negative sampling for scarce OpTC malicious behavior subgraphs
